profile.headline: Engineering Leader | Principal Software Engineer | Cloud & SaaS Platforms | Architecture Strategy | Operational Excellence | Team Development
profile.summary: Principal Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience building and scaling SaaS platforms, cloud-native applications, and enterprise software solutions. Experienced in software architecture, AWS cloud services, REST APIs, event-driven systems, Redis caching, and multi-tenant application design. Passionate about solving complex technical challenges, mentoring engineers, and driving platform modernization through innovation, operational excellence, and AI-assisted development tools. Trusted to lead critical production escalations, influence technical strategy, and deliver solutions aligned with business goals.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for technical leadership and architecture strategy across business-critical SaaS platforms, guiding engineering decisions that support scalability, reliability, security, and long-term product growth. Led modernization efforts for REST API platforms by leveraging AI-assisted development tools, including Cursor, to improve development velocity, code quality, and maintainability. Partner with leadership, product, operations, and support organizations to drive strategic initiatives, improve operational excellence, and deliver measurable business outcomes. Act as the primary engineering escalation contact for customer-impacting production issues while coaching engineers, influencing technical direction, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), REST APIs and +8 skills

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description: Led architecture and platform modernization initiatives for a multi-tenant SaaS access control platform, driving improvements in scalability, maintainability, and deployment efficiency. Designed secure REST APIs and enterprise-grade solutions that enabled tenant self-service capabilities, streamlined business operations, and enhanced customer experience. Collaborated closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into scalable technical solutions while establishing architectural standards and best practices. Played a key role in reducing technical debt, improving platform reliability, and supporting long-term product growth.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Contributed to the design and development of core platform capabilities for a cloud-based access control solution, focusing on API architecture, system integrations, security, and scalability. Partnered with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to deliver customer-facing features, modernize platform capabilities, and establish a strong technical foundation that supported future growth and architectural evolution.

positions.title: Consultant & Senior Analyst, Solution Development
positions.description:
Delivered enterprise software solutions and modernization initiatives for Fortune 500 and public sector clients, partnering with cross-functional teams in Agile environments to design, develop, and enhance mission-critical applications. Built and maintained web and backend solutions using C#, ASP.NET, SQL Server, JavaScript, and Oracle while supporting system integrations, deployments, and operational improvements. Collaborated with business stakeholders, QA teams, and development teams to implement new functionality, optimize application performance, modernize legacy systems, and deliver high-quality solutions that aligned with evolving business needs.

Key Clients:
Blue Cross Blue Shield: Enhanced healthcare enrollment platforms and streamlined operational processes through application and database improvements.

United Technologies Corporation: Developed and supported enterprise applications for global business operations, contributing to system enhancements, deployments, and technical problem-solving.

State of Florida: Modernized legacy government systems by refactoring applications, implementing new features, and improving maintainability and performance.
positions.insights: Microsoft SQL Server, SQL Server Management Studio and +4 skills

positions.title: Technology Analyst
positions.description: Enhanced Norfolk Southern's Thoroughbred Equipment Asset Management System by modernizing legacy applications, developing a web-based inventory management portal using C#, HTML5, and Entity Framework, and implementing APIs to enable seamless data integration across enterprise systems. Contributed to improved asset visibility, operational efficiency, and data accuracy for railcar inventory and equipment management processes.

positions.title: DBA & Programming Intern
positions.description:
Developed, modified, and tested C programs for the company's Debit Card
Processing System. Researched and configured Sugar CRM to best fit the
company's needs. Implemented and tested enhancement feature requests
to enhance product functionality.

projects.title: Project Management
projects.description:
IT 3223: Software Acq & Project Management (Southern Polytechnic State University)

In a team of 3 worked on a Medical Office Management System for a mid-sized primary healthcare facility:

    - Performed requirements engineering to assess the project requirements
    - Created a project charter
    - Created a task list and a work breakdown structure
    - Created a project plan in MS Project and made a finite timeline to achieve the project goals

projects.title: Android App Development
projects.description:
CS 2340: Objects and Design (Georgia Institute of Technology)

  - Created a basic Android To-Do app backed up by a database
  - Performed design analysis
